    for p in [os.getcwd(), os.environ.get('HOME',''), '/tmp', '/var/tmp']:
        if p: cands.append(Path(p))
    return cands

        test=d/('.__oc_write_test')
        test.write_text('ok')
        test.unlink()
        chosen=d
        break
    except Exception:
        pass
